verdict.rationale: Account, transaction, balance and identity data can be retrieved programmatically through a documented Platform API with a public OpenAPI spec. Held data can be shared with an FDX open-finance platform, an open standard, and monthly statements are available as PDFs. Together these give a piecemeal path to getting data out, but nothing describes a bulk 'export everything' function or a clean exit. Missing for 10: documented bulk/full-account data export, explicit open export formats (e.g. CSV/JSON dumps), offboarding/data-deletion process, and independent corroboration of portability.
